'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Eevee the Genius''' is the sixth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the ninth and 10th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|2}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
__NOTOC__
==Blurb==
'''''THOSE NUTTY POKéMON'''''

''Looks like Almond's a pretty popular Pokémon trainer, because now Hazel's got a rival for Almond's affections...Coconut, Grandpa's other granddaughter, and a self-proclaimed scientific genius! In fact, not only is she smart, but so is her pet Eevee! Can anything that cute really be intelligent?'' 

''Then, on a trip to the fair, Doduo and Dodrio cause trouble.''
